approved_decisions.F1: Accept the synthetic Farrier and Horse Owner fixture set as the Step 2F baseline.
approved_decisions.F2: Validate lifecycle progression through explicit prior-revision pairs.
approved_decisions.F3: Retain valid gap, conflict, duplicate and protected-field review states.
approved_decisions.F4: Validate declared business outcomes in addition to schema compliance.
approved_decisions.F5: Require negative cases to fail for their named expected reason and exact error count.
approved_decisions.F6: Keep every Step 2F fixture synthetic and perform no external action.
approved_decisions.F7: Use the synthetic Field Catalogue only to test external catalogue enforcement.
approved_decisions.F8: Defer the real Equinet Field Catalogue and minimum packages to Step 3.
approved_decisions.F9: Keep Step 2E adversarial tests and prior foundation checks in regression.
